cues.text: You and Akihiko sit side by side on the sofa in the dorm lounge, facing the TV, where he has put on a video. Akihiko sits with his arms and legs crossed; you lean forward, hands clasped between your knees.
What plays is not a champion's bout but an old recording of a small boxing match, the crowd's voices coming through the speakers. Akihiko stares at the screen.
